      "source": [
        "import torch\n",
        "import torch.nn as nn\n",
        "import torch.optim as optim\n",
        "import torchvision\n",
        "import torchvision.transforms as transforms\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "device = torch.device(\"cuda\" if torch.cuda.is_available() else \"cpu\")\n",
        "print(\"Device:\", device)\n",
        "\n",
        "transform = transforms.Compose([\n",
        "    transforms.ToTensor(),\n",
        "    transforms.Normalize((0.5,), (0.5,))\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "trainset = torchvision.datasets.CIFAR10(\n",
        "    root=\"./data\",\n",
        "    train=True,\n",
        "    download=True,\n",
        "    transform=transform\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "trainloader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(\n",
        "    trainset,\n",
        "    batch_size=128,\n",
        "    shuffle=True\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "class MLP(nn.Module):\n",
        "    def __init__(self):\n",
        "        super(MLP, self).__init__()\n",
        "\n",
        "        self.network = nn.Sequential(\n",
        "            nn.Flatten(),\n",
        "            nn.Linear(3 * 32 * 32, 256),\n",
        "            nn.ReLU(),\n",
        "            nn.Linear(256, 10)\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    def forward(self, x):\n",
        "        return self.network(x)\n",
        "\n",
        "def train_model(optimizer_name):\n",
        "\n",
        "    model = MLP().to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()\n",
        "\n",
        "    if optimizer_name == \"SGD\":\n",
        "        optimizer = optim.SGD(\n",
        "            model.parameters(),\n",
        "            lr=0.01,\n",
        "            momentum=0.9\n",
        "        )\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        optimizer = optim.Adam(\n",
        "            model.parameters(),\n",
        "            lr=0.001\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    losses = []\n",
        "    accuracies = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    for epoch in range(10):\n",
        "\n",
        "        model.train()\n",
        "\n",
        "        running_loss = 0\n",
        "        correct = 0\n",
        "        total = 0\n",
        "\n",
        "        for images, labels in trainloader:\n",
        "\n",
        "            images = images.to(device)\n",
        "            labels = labels.to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "            optimizer.zero_grad()\n",
        "\n",
        "            outputs = model(images)\n",
        "\n",
        "            loss = criterion(outputs, labels)\n",
        "\n",
        "            loss.backward()\n",
        "\n",
        "            optimizer.step()\n",
        "\n",
        "            running_loss += loss.item()\n",
        "\n",
        "            _, predicted = torch.max(outputs, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "            total += labels.size(0)\n",
        "\n",
        "            correct += (predicted == labels).sum().item()\n",
        "\n",
        "        epoch_loss = running_loss / len(trainloader)\n",
        "\n",
        "        epoch_accuracy = 100 * correct / total\n",
        "\n",
        "        losses.append(epoch_loss)\n",
        "\n",
        "        accuracies.append(epoch_accuracy)\n",
        "\n",
        "        print(\n",
        "            optimizer_name,\n",
        "            \"Epoch\",\n",
        "            epoch + 1,\n",
        "            \"Loss:\",\n",
        "            round(epoch_loss, 4),\n",
        "            \"Accuracy:\",\n",
        "            round(epoch_accuracy, 2),\n",
        "            \"%\"\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    return losses, accuracies\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nTraining SGD with Momentum...\")\n",
        "sgd_loss, sgd_acc = train_model(\"SGD\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nTraining Adam...\")\n",
        "adam_loss, adam_acc = train_model(\"Adam\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    sgd_loss,\n",
        "    label=\"SGD with Momentum\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    adam_loss,\n",
        "    label=\"Adam\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Epoch\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Loss\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"SGD with Momentum vs Adam - Loss\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.legend()\n",
        "plt.grid()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    sgd_acc,\n",
        "    label=\"SGD with Momentum\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    adam_acc,\n",
        "    label=\"Adam\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Epoch\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Accuracy (%)\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"SGD with Momentum vs Adam - Accuracy\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.legend()\n",
        "plt.grid()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ]
    }
